status: Public derived integration and verification table; rebuilt from the released input and computed outputs.

computed_sources.narrative_order: hippo_prev_global and hippo_next_global in the public input

privacy.event_keys: Existing neutral event keys from the public input

validation.identifiers: Existing public keys retained consistently across participant, event, segment, chain and adjacency fields.

sequence_conventions.order: Narrative order within participant-global directed chains; not the timing of recalled experiences.
sequence_conventions.ordering_authority: hippo_prev_global and hippo_next_global in source_input; never infer order by sorting event identifiers.
sequence_conventions.membership_scope: Canonical 4-D four-cluster membership; independent of the five basin-state assignments.
sequence_conventions.run_definition: A maximal consecutive stretch of event-states assigned to the same macro-cluster, including single-event runs.
sequence_conventions.boundary_rule: A missing previous or next event-state is treated as not belonging to the current macro-cluster when deriving macro_seq_role.
sequence_conventions.role_status: Deterministic sequence descriptors; not interpretive annotations or event-boundary rules. The excluded legacy structural_role field is not reinstated.

adjacent_event_fields.hippo_prev_global: Identifier of the preceding event-state; blank at the chain start.
adjacent_event_fields.hippo_next_global: Identifier of the following event-state; blank at the chain end.

chain_id.definition: Identifier of the participant-global directed narrative chain, spanning transcript segments.
chain_id.current_export_format: participant_id_norm followed by :0; one chain per participant in this export.

step.definition: Zero-based position in the chain, reconstructed from authoritative directed event links.

macro_cluster_prev.definition: Canonical macro-cluster membership of the immediately preceding event-state in the same chain.
macro_cluster_prev.csv_encoding: Blank for missing; populated labels appear as 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, or 4.0.

macro_cluster_next.definition: Canonical macro-cluster membership of the immediately following event-state in the same chain.
macro_cluster_next.csv_encoding: Blank for missing; populated labels appear as 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, or 4.0.

macro_seq_role.definition: Position within a consecutive run of event-states assigned to the same macro-cluster.

allowed_values.single: One-event run: neither adjacent event-state belongs to the current macro-cluster.
allowed_values.entry: First event-state of a run of at least two: only the next adjacent event-state belongs to the current macro-cluster.
allowed_values.core: Interior event-state of a run of at least three: both adjacent event-states belong to the current macro-cluster.
allowed_values.exit: Last event-state of a run of at least two: only the previous adjacent event-state belongs to the current macro-cluster.

macro_seen_before.definition: Whether the current macro-cluster occurred at any earlier step in the same chain, including earlier event-states in the current run.
macro_seen_before.rule: current macro-cluster is in the set of macro-clusters at steps less than the current step

macro_return_event.definition: Marks the first event-state on re-entry into a previously visited macro-cluster after at least one intervening event-state in another macro-cluster.
macro_return_event.rule: macro_seen_before is True AND macro_cluster_prev differs from macro_cluster_D4_K4

additional_fields.segment_id: Processing-segment label parsed from uid; not an analytical state.
additional_fields.Dim0_to_Dim12: Coordinates from the fixed full-sample MCA solution.
additional_fields.macro_cluster_D4_K4: Canonical four-cluster membership in the four-dimensional geometry.
additional_fields.basin_columns: Solution-specific basin-state memberships. D2 refers to fitting in Dim0 and Dim3.

removed_field_reasons.hippo_id: Duplicate original event identifier; hippo_id_norm supplies the public key.
removed_field_reasons.uid_norm: Duplicate processing-segment identifier; uid supplies the public key.
removed_field_reasons.hippo_weight_tag: Auxiliary annotation metadata unused in the public calculations and absent from the source input.
removed_field_reasons.n_theme_assignments_event: Auxiliary count unused in the public calculations; equals n_excerpts_event for all 256 supplied rows.

added_field_sources.conj_rep: Copied unchanged from the public input; representational domain used in boundary summaries.
added_field_sources.anchor_changed_to_next_within_segment: Copied unchanged from the public input; privacy-preserving flag used in boundary summaries.

verification_limit: Comparison with existing release references and reconstruction of sequence descriptors do not establish that the full analytical pipeline has been rerun.
